text:
paul: quick heads-up — Sasha's bday is next Thu. thinking low-key: surprise Zoom + small desk plant or a mailed care package for remote folks? :tada:
sasha: lol i'm terrible at surprises but love plants :seedling: (also totally fine with no fuss)
kevin: vote: :seedling: plant / :package: care package / :zoom: surprise zoom
alyssa: :seedling:
jenna: :zoom: (i can host the call if we do a quick 10-min thing)
maria: remote folks might prefer a care package. estimated cost $25 each (snacks + candle)
paul: hr-bot, can you drop the calendar reminder and the RSVP link?
hr-bot: Reminder: Sasha Birthday — Thu 3:00pm-3:20pm. Add to calendar: https://calendar.redwood/evt/1832109999
kevin: dietary note: Sasha is nut-free FYI
paul: ok small poll: 1) desk plant in office (we wrap it) 2) mailed care package (remote incl.) 3) just a short surprise zoom + card. Reply with emoji
kevin: :seedling:
jenna: :zoom:
alyssa: :seedling:
maria: :package:
paul: current tally: 2 plant, 1 zoom, 1 package. voting closes Wed noon.
jenna: if plant wins i can pick up a medium snake plant from PlantHaus Tue morning. they do kraft wrapping
maria: if package wins i can coordinate shipments and collect addresses (will DM)
paul: small note on surprise zoom logistics: keep it to 7-8 mins, everyone unmutes for quick toast, then cake emoji in chat :cake:
kevin: i can do a short 20-30s congrats message re: Sasha's help on the optimizer rollout
paul: can folks drop 1-2 lines for the card here and i'll paste into a physical card
jenna: "Thanks for always making meetings shorter and answers clearer!"
kevin: "Couldn't have shipped the Dedicated rollout without your config wizardry."
alyssa: "Your playlists are 10/10. Happy birthday!"
maria: "Hope you have a relaxing day — you deserve it."
sasha: y'all, i'm charmed. seriously, thanks <3
hr-bot: Calendar updated: Sasha Birthday (Add to your calendar: https://calendar.redwood/evt/1832109999)
paul: final plan: plant wins (3:1 after late vote). jenna will pick up plant Tue 9:30. maria will DM remote folks about a small $25 e-gift instead of package. jenna will bring a card and wrap.
paul: checklist: plant (jenna), card + wrap (jenna), short zoom host (jenna), ship e-gifts (maria). any objections?
kevin: all good from me
jenna: i'll bring a tiny ribbon and balloon. see y'all Thu 3:00! :balloon:
paul: closing thread  thanks everyone :tada:
